correctness.rationale: Exact integration of the ODE gives the positive-trajectory recovery formulas; the positive-equilibrium inverse Jacobian gives the rank dichotomy; and symbolic algebra verifies the Fisher covariance, sharp correlation floor, and equilibrium sign pairing.

originality.rationale: Classical Klausmeier equilibria and generic identifiability/Fisher theory are credited as prior art. The claim is restricted to the source-specific full-state identifiability dichotomy and exact equilibrium-only correlation law and floor for arXiv:2609.18231v1.

value.rationale: The result analytically separates structural non-identifiability on the desert invariant set from severe but full-rank practical collinearity on the vegetated branch, including a sharp correlation lower bound of 0.99729144 at the source value m=0.45.
